title: Bootstrap Sourdough — Compilation Failures Inverted as Knowledge
principle: Every error is a culture. Every fix is a fermentation. The sourdough feeds the next build.

astrolabe.metaphor: The first computer measured the stars. Our compilation errors measure the gaps in our type system.

mechanics.name: Lever
mechanics.maps_to: cfg(unix)/cfg(not(unix)) — platform leverage, same force different fulcrum

mechanics.name: Pulley
mechanics.maps_to: serde defaults — reduce friction by adding intermediate fields

mechanics.name: Gear
mechanics.maps_to: SecurityLevel enum — interlocking types that transmit correctness

mechanics.name: Hydraulic Press
mechanics.maps_to: cellmembrane-types crate — one canonical source pressurizes all downstream

fermentation_log.error: swarmVine: handle_tarpc_stream not found on Windows
fermentation_log.culture: Platform gates — tarpc is Unix-only, the call site wasn't guarded
fermentation_log.knowledge: Every Unix-only function needs a twin gate for Windows. The organism is cross-platform.

fermentation_log.error: toadStool: 24 compilation errors — ServiceDiscoveryConfig missing fields
fermentation_log.culture: Type starvation — the config struct was defined without serde derives or canonical fields
fermentation_log.fix: Added cache_ttl_secs, timeout_secs, methods, fallbacks, retries, enable_ipv6 + Serialize/Deserialize
fermentation_log.knowledge: Config structs need ALL fields from the ecosystem spec. Serde defaults are the elastic buffer.

fermentation_log.culture: Type orphan — SecurityLevel was removed during consolidation but never replaced
fermentation_log.fix: Created security_level.rs in cellmembrane-types with None/Standard/High/Maximum + traits
fermentation_log.knowledge: Types that live in multiple crates must live in the canonical crate. The hydraulic press.

fermentation_log.error: toadStool: HealthStatus missing sick() + with_uptime() + with_check()
fermentation_log.culture: Builder starvation — the canonical type had ok() but not the failure constructors
fermentation_log.fix: Added sick(reason), with_uptime(secs), with_check(check) to cellmembrane-types ecosystem.rs
fermentation_log.knowledge: If you can construct success, you must be able to construct failure. Biology needs both.

fermentation_log.error: toadStool: 4x String vs &str type mismatch in with_capability()
fermentation_log.culture: Ownership friction — &str literals passed where String expected
fermentation_log.knowledge: The spring: .to_string() is the elastic conversion between borrowed and owned. Simple but necessary.
